## Penguin Size and Mass by Sex and Species





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- palmerpenguins::penguins
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df |>
  summarise(
    .by = c(species, sex),
    across(where(is.numeric), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
